subject.title: [Bug] web_fetch fails in dual-stack networks when DNS returns IPv6 special-use addresses

question: Should `web_fetch` allow a hostname when at least one resolved address is public and allowed, while filtering blocked DNS answers out of the pinned pool?
rationale: The mechanical patch is bounded, but it changes the default outbound SSRF policy for `web_fetch` and should reflect maintainer security intent rather than automated cleanup judgment.

options.title: Approve mixed-answer filtering
options.body: Treat blocked DNS answers as unusable candidates, fail only when every answer is blocked, and require focused SSRF tests before landing.

options.title: Keep strict any-blocked policy
options.body: Preserve the current fail-closed behavior and point affected deployments to trusted proxy or fake-IP opt-in configuration where applicable.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the default strict policy and solve polluted DNS handling only through an operator-controlled `web_fetch` SSRF policy path.

recommendation.title: Approve mixed-answer filtering
recommendation.body: Treat blocked DNS answers as unusable candidates, fail only when every answer is blocked, and require focused SSRF tests before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This login is tied to the central SSRF assertion and IPv6 special-use blocking commits that define the current security boundary.
